## Summary

Read T-4007, listed pods in `orders`, and pulled logs from `orders-api-8d6f5c7b9-wm4xr`. The question was framed as a cost/log-volume judgment call, but the debug output contains a plaintext DB password and a live Paygate bearer token in a config dump line, and those logs are being shipped to an external vendor. Because credential rotation is restricted to the security team (per the ticket) and vendor-side log purging is outside my reach, I escalated rather than resolving with a simple "turn debug off." The owner should still flip `LOG_LEVEL` back to `info` right away as a first step.
